messages:
Alice Chen: Quick heads-up — vendor wants to include our KMS integration and recent RBAC changes in the upcoming security assessment. Can we confirm scope and a point of contact?
Marco Ruiz: I can lead the KMS/RBAC section. Need to confirm which KMS key policies are considered "in-scope" (customer keys vs platform keys).
Priya Patel: @Marco +1. From compliance: we only expose customer-managed keys for Private deployments. Hosted uses our platform-managed CMKs. Vendor should get access only to control-plane artifacts, not actual key material.
Dan O'Neill: For clarity — we should provide the key policy JSON and IAM bindings, but not ARNs that give access. Also share rotational schedule and KMS audit log samples.
Alice Chen: Agreed. Also need to map RBAC changes since Jan 2025, including the new cross-team admin role. Can someone assemble the diff?
Zoe Kim: I have the RBAC diff exported from vault-admin. Will paste a snippet.
Zoe Kim: ```json
{"role":"cross-team-admin","permissions":["deploy:all","kms:encrypt","kms:decrypt"],"created":"2025-02-12T18:32:00Z"}
```
Marco Ruiz: That snippet shows why vendor will ask about `kms:decrypt`. We should document why cross-team-admin has that permission and any compensating controls (e.g., scoped usage, approval workflow).
Priya Patel: Also note we added per-request approval in the console for decrypt operations since Feb. Include the approval audit trail in the package.
Dan O'Neill: On audit logging: infra-bot collected examples from prod for the last 90 days. Are the anonymized logs acceptable to send?
infra-bot: Uploaded anonymized_kms_audit_sample.log -> S3://redwood-internal/sec-exchange/1767501234/anonymized_kms_audit_sample.log :lock: (access logged)
Alice Chen: Perfect. Next: remediation tracker. We need one owner per finding category. I'll own KMS misconfig and RBAC review. @Priya you own audit logging clarifications?
Priya Patel: I'm in. I'll prepare a short doc: what we will hand to the vendor, what we will not, and redaction rules.
Marco Ruiz: Timelines: vendor kickoff 2025-06-02. Proposed internal readiness review 2025-05-26. We should schedule a 30-min sync next week to finalize handoff artifacts.
Dan O'Neill: Can we add a checklist in the doc with items: key policy exports, rotation schedule, audit log samples, RBAC diffs, change approvals, and temporary access tokens created for the assessment?
Zoe Kim: I'll add the RBAC diff + PR references. PRs: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/712, /pull/745.
Alice Chen: Retest note: if vendor flags an issue, retest window needs staging/replication instructions. We should predefine who can authorize a retest and the SLA (48 hours for critical, 5 business days for high).
Marco Ruiz: Sounds good. @Alice, can you open a JIRA ticket for the remediation tracker with those SLAs and owners? I'll attach the key policy docs.
Alice Chen: Created RED-2247 with labels: pen-test, kms, rbac, audit. Linked infra artifacts.
Priya Patel: One more: encryption-at-rest controls — vendor may request evidence of volume-level encryption. I'll pull the EBS/GCP disk policy exports and confirm.
Dan O'Neill: Thanks. If anyone needs temporary IAM roles for the vendor, ping infra and include expiry <=72 hours.
Zoe Kim: Quick question — do we want to give vendor a read-only role that can query CloudTrail/Stackdriver or should we produce exported slices only?
Priya Patel: Export slices only. No direct access to logs or KMS console. Better for audit and least privilege.
Alice Chen: OK, plan agreed: package artifacts + redacted logs, no direct KMS console access, read-only infra snapshots only via exports. Sync scheduled for 2025-05-15 10:00 PT. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
